nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Use one explore sub-agent as the sole owner of the read-only product source. Use `woo_products_list` with `perPage=100`, increasing `page` until a short or empty terminal page. Preserve every product's ID, full name, SKU, first observed category name, current `price`, `stock_quantity`, and all metadata entries needed to resolve the exact stock-threshold, supplier-name, and supplier-email keys. Do not call per-product endpoints unless a listed row demonstrably omits a required field. Persist the complete Product_ID-keyed rows to one runtime-unique JSON under the dynamically resolved workspace and return only its path, SHA-256, schema, page/row counts, missing-field controls, and read-back result. Do not calculate prices or create the workbook.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one Coder sub-agent as the sole writer of `inventory_repricing_report.xlsx`. Consume the verified product JSON and canonical compact mappings; create the exact four sheets, exact headers, complete row sets, task-defined sorting/status rules, truncation, rounding, and literal values. Recompute no category mapping. Read every sheet back and return the workspace path plus per-sheet row counts, all distinct category-to-multiplier pairs, and the seven requested aggregate checks.
